name: Settlement Obligation 9
definition: Provides details about the settlement obligation.

SettlementObligationIdentification.name: Settlement Obligation Identification
SettlementObligationIdentification.definition: Provides the identification of the settlement obligation.

FinancialInstrumentIdentification.name: Financial Instrument Identification
FinancialInstrumentIdentification.definition: Provides details about the security identification.

IntendedSettlementDate.name: Intended Settlement Date
IntendedSettlementDate.definition: Intended settlement date of the position.

Quantity.name: Quantity
Quantity.definition: Specifies the quantity related to the settlement obligation.

SettlementAmount.name: Settlement Amount
SettlementAmount.definition: Provides the total amount to be settled.

PlaceOfTrade.name: Place Of Trade
PlaceOfTrade.definition: Place at which the security is traded.

TradingCapacity.name: Trading Capacity
TradingCapacity.definition: Identifies the trading capacity of seller.

SafekeepingPlace.name: Safekeeping Place
SafekeepingPlace.definition: Place where the securities are safe-kept, physically or notionally. This place can be, for example, a local custodian, a Central Securities Depository (CSD) or an International Central Securities Depository (ICSD).

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Clearing member account at the central securities depository.

SecuritiesMovementType.name: Securities Movement Type
SecuritiesMovementType.definition: Indicates if the obligation will result in a receive or a delivery of securities.

Payment.name: Payment
Payment.definition: Specifies the amount to be paid under a specific obligation.

SettlementParties.name: Settlement Parties
SettlementParties.definition: Provides details on the parties that are part of the settlement chain.

AdditionalSettlementObligationDetails.name: Additional Settlement Obligation Details
AdditionalSettlementObligationDetails.definition: Provides additional information about the settlement obligation details.
